notes.title: 🎄 Happy Holidays from the Pretty Underground Team! 🎄
notes.content:
As the year comes to an end, we want to take a moment to thank you all for the incredible support you've shown us so far. Knowing that so many of you see potential in our little top-down shooter is an amazing motivation to keep pushing forward. 🚀

Speaking of pushing forward – the demo is shaping up nicely! We're hard at work making sure it delivers the chaos and fun we envisioned, and we can’t wait to share more with you in the new year. Expect updates soon, including sneak peeks at what we’ve been building.

For now, we wish you and your loved ones a warm, cozy, and joyful holiday season. Thank you for being part of this journey with us – here’s to an exciting 2025 ahead!

🎅 Stay tuned, stay underground! 🎮

notes.title: Pretty Underground demo is coming!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce that we are currently working on Pretty Underground demo![/b] The road ahead is long and bumpy, but we're doing our best, so expect some good news soon!

One of our latest development milestones is the heavy weapons system: more about it in upcoming news, but there's gonna be a ton of fun with miniguns, flamethrowers and full auto shotguns. Stay tuned!

[b]We wish you a spooky Halloween, everyone![/b]
